executiveSummary: The audit uncovered a concentration of critical and serious accessibility findings that prevent many users from fully engaging with your site. These include missing image descriptions, unlabeled buttons and links, and videos without captions, all of which directly impact usability for people relying on assistive technology. Additional issues like insufficient color contrast, small touch targets, and disabled zooming further limit access for users with visual or motor impairments. Beyond accessibility, invalid structured data and JavaScript-dependent content risk harming your search visibility and user experience. Addressing these findings will broaden your audience reach and improve trust in your brand.

themes.title: Missing alternative text for images
themes.businessImpact: Visitors using screen readers cannot understand the content or purpose of images, leading to lost engagement and trust.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 1.1.1 (Non-text Content), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to add descriptive alt text to all images on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to mark purely decorative images with an empty alt attribute or ARIA role
Ask your technical provider to audit and correct any remaining missing or unclear alt text

themes.title: Buttons without discernible text
themes.businessImpact: Users relying on assistive technology cannot identify button functions, making key actions impossible to complete.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to add visible, descriptive text or ARIA labels to all buttons on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to ensure button icons are paired with accessible text
Ask your technical provider to test button accessibility across all interactive elements

themes.title: Links without discernible text
themes.businessImpact: Screen reader users cannot understand link destinations, reducing navigation clarity and user confidence.
themes.legalRelevance: Criteria 2.4.4 (Link Purpose (In Context)) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to replace vague link text (e.g., 'click here') with descriptive phrases on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to ensure all links have meaningful, context-rich text
Ask your technical provider to audit links for accessibility compliance

themes.title: Zooming and scaling disabled
themes.businessImpact: Users with low vision cannot zoom in to read content, excluding a key audience from accessing your site.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 1.4.4 (Resize Text), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to remove any viewport meta tags that disable zooming on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to ensure the site remains usable when zoomed to 200%
Ask your technical provider to test accessibility with zooming enabled

themes.title: Frames without accessible names
themes.businessImpact: Assistive technology cannot describe frame content, leaving users unaware of embedded information or actions.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to add title attributes or ARIA labels to all iframes and frames on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to ensure frame names describe their purpose or content
Ask your technical provider to verify frame accessibility across all pages

themes.title: Videos missing captions
themes.businessImpact: Deaf or hard-of-hearing visitors cannot access audio content, excluding a significant audience segment.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 1.2.2 (Captions (Prerecorded)), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to add captions or subtitles to all videos on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to ensure captions are synchronized and accurate
Ask your technical provider to test video accessibility for compliance with WCAG 2.2

themes.title: Insufficient color contrast
themes.businessImpact: Users with low vision or color blindness may struggle to read text, reducing content accessibility and engagement.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 1.4.3 (Contrast (Minimum)), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to adjust foreground and background colors to meet WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to test color combinations for readability
Ask your technical provider to ensure contrast compliance across all interactive elements

themes.title: Small touch targets
themes.businessImpact: Mobile users, especially those with motor impairments, may accidentally tap the wrong element, frustrating the experience.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 2.5.8 (Target Size (Minimum)), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to increase touch target sizes to at least 24x24 pixels on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to add sufficient spacing between interactive elements
Ask your technical provider to test touch target accessibility on mobile devices

themes.title: Content invisible without JavaScript
themes.businessImpact: Search engines and some users may see empty or incomplete pages, harming discoverability and user experience.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to ensure critical content is available in the raw HTML on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to implement progressive enhancement for JavaScript-dependent content
Ask your technical provider to test page rendering with JavaScript disabled

themes.title: Invalid structured data (JSON-LD)
themes.businessImpact: Search engines cannot interpret your structured data, missing opportunities to enhance search visibility and rich results.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to validate and fix all JSON-LD blocks on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to test structured data using Google’s Rich Results Test
Ask your technical provider to ensure JSON-LD syntax is error-free and properly formatted

themes.title: Skipped heading levels
themes.businessImpact: Screen reader users may find the page structure confusing, making navigation and comprehension harder.
themes.legalRelevance: Criterion 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships), WCAG 2.2 level AA, referenced by the EN 301 549 standard.
recommendedActions: Ask your technical provider to correct heading hierarchies to avoid skipped levels on the affected pages
Ask your technical provider to ensure headings follow a logical order (e.g., h1 → h2 → h3)
Ask your technical provider to audit heading structure for accessibility compliance

notes: No site context was provided. Priorities reflect finding severity only, not stated business goals.
